A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 43-page versions of the same GraphSHAP-IQ paper. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original GNN accuracy, computational complexity, approximation quality, runtime measurements, and molecule and water-network case studies in Sections 4–5 and Appendices F–G.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1 and 4 and the experimental figures in the main text and Appendix G.

M1.justification: The graph games, node masking, exact and approximate GraphSHAP-IQ procedures, MI-to-SI conversion, and interaction-informed variants remain unchanged. The Section 2.2 edits clarify the existing GNN description without changing its architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight classification datasets—BNZ, FLC, MTG, ALC, PRT, ENZ, CX2, and BZR—and the Hanoi-based WAQ regression dataset. No dataset, task, or application scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix G.4 retain the same comparator sets, including the KernelSHAP and KernelSHAP-IQ variants, permutation sampling, SVARM, SVARM-IQ, SHAP-IQ, L-Shapley, and the corresponding interaction-informed variants.

E3.justification: The splits, architectures, training budgets, graph selections, metrics, and model-call budgets remain unchanged in Appendices F–G. Section 4.2 replaces 'varying λ (model calls)' with 'varying the model calls'; the underlying protocol and Figure 4 axis are unchanged.

E4.justification: The model-depth comparison, linear versus deep readout analysis, runtime analysis, and water-network and molecule case studies are retained unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions specify two independent baseline iterations per budget in Appendix G.4.1. The standard-error bands in Figures 12–15 and median/quartile reporting in Figures 7–9 are also unchanged.

E6.justification: The accuracy tables, complexity and approximation curves, runtime results, and qualitative case-study findings are unchanged. Figure 4's repositioned inset retains the same plotted results and 1.9 s and 2.0 s annotations.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, linearity assumption, invariance and sparsity results, complexity bounds, and proofs remain unchanged, including Appendices B–E. The shortened introduction to Möbius interactions preserves Equation (1) and its mathematical meaning.

C1.justification: The abstract, four stated contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about exact any-order interactions, computational savings, approximation, SI-Graphs, and interactions beyond receptive fields under deep readouts.

C2.justification: The interpretations of approximation quality, molecular structures, water flow, and nonlinear readouts are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning linear pooling/output layers and baseline masking.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement and appendices retain the same pseudocode, hyperparameters, hardware, compute-time information, dataset sources and licenses, and code-access instructions. No implementation or reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and research positioning are unchanged. Section 2.1 removes a list of alternative MI names and accompanying citations, but those works remain cited elsewhere, including Appendices B and E; the comparisons with prior methods are retained.

P1.justification: v2 reverses the first two authors and renumbers affiliations, shortens the MI introduction, changes 'graph regression' to 'graph prediction tasks' in Section 2.2, clarifies the model-call wording in Section 4.2, and corrects 'S summary' in Appendix A. The overall organization is unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 4's small runtime inset is repositioned. Local text and equation reflow changes spacing and page breaks on pages 3–5, including moving the classification sentence onto page 4. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves expository precision: Section 2.2 describes pooling for graph prediction generally, and Section 4.2 identifies Figure 4's horizontal variable as model calls without conflating it with λ. Minor wording and typo corrections also help readability. The algorithms, proofs, empirical evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, so the gain is limited.
